name: Master Enterprise Consolidation, Traceability & Implementation Baseline
purpose: Consolidate and reconcile the governed Phase 00-20 specification into the final GES v1.0 implementation baseline.
implementation_waves: Product definition, requirements governance, decision rights and lock discipline
Core platform, enterprise data model and master library registry
Stabilize shared schemas, tenancy, identity and libraries
Estimating/cost intelligence and AI construction intelligence
Project management, CRM, HR, finance, procurement and fleet
BI, HSE, documents/drawings, GIS/reality capture, machine control
Build intelligence, compliance and field/digital systems
Integrate time, resources and commercial control
Enterprise integration, deployment, testing, governance and production readiness
Converge and harden platform for production
Master consolidation, cross-phase reconciliation, final traceability and implementation baseline
Approve and lock GES v1.0 implementation baseline
lock_rule: Do not declare GES v1.0 locked until blocking gaps/conflicts are resolved or formally accepted, required cross-phase approvals are recorded, and the final baseline manifest is signed/approved.
source_note: Counts are consolidated directly from the Phase 01-20 ZIP repositories available in the build workspace. Phase 00 remains a separately governed product-definition source for final approval.
